disclaimer: Simplified estimate for national income tax only. Employment income deduction, local inhabitant tax (approximately 10%), reconstruction surtax (2.1%), social insurance premiums, and personal exemptions are not included.

regimes.label: National Income Tax (2024) (Resident)
regimes.notes: National income tax only. The 2.1% reconstruction surtax is applied as surcharge. Local inhabitant tax (approximately 10%) is separate and not included. Employment income deduction varies by income level and is not applied here.

regimes.label: Non-Resident
regimes.notes: Non-residents are taxed via flat withholding at 20.42% (20% national + 2.1% reconstruction surtax) on Japan-source employment income, with no deductions.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
